privacy-policy.title: Privacy policy
privacy-policy.html:
This Privacy Policy outlines how DUBA KOSHER KITCHEN CO. L.L.C ("Duba", "we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data in compliance with the applicable laws of the United Arab Emirates (UAE), including the Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data (PDPL) and applicable regulations from the Ministry of Economy.

By using our website [https://dubakosher.com], placing an order, or contacting us, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect and process the following types of information:

Identity and Contact Information: Full name, phone number, email, delivery address

Order and Transactional Data: Order history, delivery preferences

Payment Information: Credit/debit card details (processed via secure payment gateway – we do not store this information)

Usage Data: IP address, browser type, device information, and usage behavior via cookies

2. Legal Basis for Processing (UAE PDPL)

We collect and process your personal data under the following lawful bases:

Performance of a contract (to fulfill your food order)

Compliance with UAE legal obligations (tax, invoicing, and consumer protection laws)

Your explicit consent (e.g., marketing opt-in)

Legitimate interests (service improvement, fraud prevention)

3. Use of Your Information

We use the collected data to:

Fulfill food orders and deliver them to you

Process secure payments through authorized gateways

Provide customer support and order updates

Comply with UAE commercial and tax regulations

Analyze usage to improve our website and services

4. Payment Security and Data Protection

All credit/debit card details and personally identifiable information will NOT be stored, sold, shared, rented, or leased to any third parties.

https://dubakosher.com will NOT pass any debit/credit card details to third parties.

We use Telr as our secure payment gateway, which complies with PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards).

Your data is protected using SSL encryption and secure server infrastructure.

5. Data Retention

We retain personal data only as long as required to:

Fulfill your order

Comply with UAE laws (e.g., accounting and tax)

Resolve disputes or legal claims

You may request data deletion at any time (unless legally required to retain it).

6. Sharing of Information

We do not sell or rent your personal data.
We may share your information with:

Delivery providers – for order fulfillment

Payment processors – for secure payment handling

Government authorities – where required by UAE law

7. Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies and analytics to improve user experience. You may disable cookies via your browser, but this may impact certain site features.

8. International Transfers

Your data is stored and processed in the UAE. If we use third-party providers outside the UAE, we ensure they meet adequate data protection standards.

9. Children’s Privacy

Users under the age of 18 are not permitted to use or register on our website. We do not knowingly collect data from minors.

10. Your Rights (Under UAE PDPL)

You have the right to:

Access your personal data

Request corrections or deletion

Withdraw consent for marketing communications

File a complaint with the UAE Data Office if your rights are violated

For any request, contact: office@dubacatering.com

11. Updates to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Updates will be posted with the revised date at the top. Continued use of the site after changes indicates your acceptance.

12. Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or your personal data:

📧 Email: office@dubacatering.com
📞 Phone: +971-55-906-0717
📍 Office: Dubai, United Arab Emirates

refund-policy.title: Refund policy
refund-policy.html:
At DUBA KOSHER KITCHEN CO. L.L.C ("Duba", "we", "our"), customer satisfaction is our top priority. Due to the nature of our business — delivering freshly prepared kosher meals — we are unable to accept returns once the food has been delivered. However, we do allow cancellations and refunds under certain conditions.

1. Cancellation Policy

Same-day orders: Cannot be canceled or refunded after the order is placed, as preparation begins immediately.

Scheduled orders (for future delivery): May be canceled within 24 hour of placing the order to qualify for a full refund.

2. Refund Eligibility

A refund or replacement may be issued only in the following cases:

The order delivered is incorrect

The food is damaged or not suitable for consumption due to our handling

The order was not delivered as confirmed

Customers must report the issue within 2 hours of receiving the order, along with photos and order number, by contacting us via email or WhatsApp.

3. Refund Process

Refunds will be done only through the original mode of payment

Refunds will be processed within 10 to 45 days, depending on the issuing bank of the credit card

Delivery charges are non-refundable unless the issue was caused by our error

4. Contact for Refunds or Issues

📧 Email: office@dubacatering.com
📞 Phone: +971-55-906-0717

shipping-policy.title: Shipping policy
shipping-policy.html:
This Shipping Policy outlines how DUBA KOSHER KITCHEN CO. L.L.C ("Duba", "we", "our") delivers orders placed through our website https://dubakosher.com.

1. Delivery Method

All orders are delivered by a dedicated courier, under proper food safety and handling standards, ensuring that meals remain fresh and secure during transport.

2. Delivery Areas and Fees

We currently deliver to the following areas in the United Arab Emirates:

Dubai
Flat-rate delivery fee: AED 48

Abu Dhabi
Same-day delivery is available.
Delivery fees vary based on the destination within Abu Dhabi.
👉 For exact pricing and availability, please contact us directly before placing your order.

We do not offer international delivery at this time.

3. Delivery Timeframes

Dubai:
Orders are typically delivered on the same day, depending on availability and cut-off time.

Abu Dhabi:
Same-day delivery is available; however, please contact us in advance to coordinate logistics and confirm timing and delivery cost.

Note: Delivery times may vary during high-demand periods, weekends, or holidays. We’ll notify you of any delays.

4. Delivery Conditions

A recipient must be present at the delivery address to receive the order.

Incorrect addresses or missed deliveries may incur additional charges.

Deliveries are made Sunday to Friday. No deliveries on Shabbat or major holidays.

5. Delivery Confirmation

Once your order is on the way, we will notify you via WhatsApp or email with an estimated arrival time and courier details if available.
